# comfyops-mcp

> Local generative AI engine — wraps ComfyUI for image/video/upscale/inpaint generation on RTX 4090.

## Documentation
- [README.md](./README.md)
- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt) — full tool documentation
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — agent behavioral instructions

## Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/comfyops-mcp
cd comfyops-mcp
uv sync
.\start.ps1
```

## Key Tools
- `comfy_generate` — image, video, upscale, inpaint, edit
- `comfy_workflows` — list, get, validate, register curated ComfyUI workflows
- `comfy_models` — list_installed, check_vram, health
- `comfy_library` — recent, search, record generations
- `comfy_agentic_assist` — SEP-1577 multi-step generation planning

## Ports
- 11086 ComfyUI sidecar
- 11087 Backend (FastMCP HTTP)
- 11088 Frontend (Vite dashboard)
